title: Research to Patent Commercialization Radar Input
description: Pass technology topics. For each one the radar pulls recent Google Scholar papers and Google Patents filings, then scores how far the field has moved from research toward commercialization.

topics.title: Technology topics
topics.description: Free text technology or research topics. One row per topic. Example: ["solid state battery electrolyte", "perovskite solar cell", "mRNA cancer vaccine"].

yearFrom.title: Earliest year
yearFrom.description: Lower bound on paper publication and patent filing year. Defaults to three years ago. 0 also means three years ago.

maxTopics.title: Max topics
maxTopics.description: Hard cap on topics scanned per run. Each topic triggers one Scholar call and one Patents call.

papersPerTopic.title: Papers per topic
papersPerTopic.description: How many Scholar papers to pull per topic for the research-momentum signal.

patentsPerTopic.title: Patents per topic
patentsPerTopic.description: How many patent filings to pull per topic for the patent-activity signal.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Drop topics scoring below this convergence score (0 to 100). 0 keeps everything with any data.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy passed through to the Scholar and Patents children. Both default to Apify residential, which is required for Google.
